aboutUs.heading: About Us
aboutUs.body: At NGen, we don't just teach technology, we engineer the future. We empower learners aged 6 to 18 to become innovators, creators, and leaders who can navigate and shape the digital world with confidence, creativity, and purpose.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To deliver globally accredited, AI-powered education that blends technology, entrepreneurship, and creativity, empowering every learner to lead, innovate, and shine in the digital future.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To create a generation that doesn't wait for the future, but designs it. A world where every young mind learns to think critically, build boldly, and lead with purpose.
